title: Insiders report sources afraid to come forward

plain: People with firsthand knowledge of secret UFO work are said to exist but to be afraid to come forward, and the men close to them keep saying so. A Senate staffer named Kurt McConnell tells Michels that the figures Congress hears from, among them the physicists Hal Puthoff and Eric Davis, a former intelligence officer named David Grusch, and two former Pentagon officials, Luis Elizondo and Christopher Mellon, all say "they know people" whom investigators would like to hear from. If true, it would mean witnesses with real knowledge are keeping silent out of fear.
